title: Rhythm and Pattern Making
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Clap names and words from the classroom. Print with cut potatoes, bottle tops and card shapes.

skills.key_step: The child names the ways of making rhythm: reciting, clapping, tapping, stamping and humming.

floor.question: Clap a steady beat with me.

steps: Name the way: clap, tap, stamp, hum or recite.

board.do: Hum a tune with lips closed.
Is that a way of making rhythm?

misconceptions.ask: Can you make rhythm without a drum?
misconceptions.repair: Make a rhythm with claps and stamps only.
Sing a line, then hum it with lips closed.

misconceptions.ask: Children say a rhyme together in a steady beat. Are they making rhythm?
misconceptions.repair: Recite a rhyme and clap the beat with it.

misconceptions.ask: Is rhythm just playing as fast as you can?
misconceptions.repair: Clap a slow pattern and a fast pattern; both are rhythms.

checks.question: Name two ways of making rhythm without an instrument.
checks.answer: any two of: clapping, tapping, stamping, humming, reciting

checks.question: Can a slow pattern be a rhythm?

skills.key_step: The child claps once for each part of a word and matches clapped patterns to words.

floor.question: Show me a clap and a stamp.

steps: Clap each part as you say it.
contexts: a name game at the start of the day

misconceptions.repair: Say the word slowly and clap each part.
Say "cat" and feel your chin drop once.
Clap your name and a friend's name and compare.

misconceptions.ask: Clap "Nai-ro-bi". How should the claps sound?
misconceptions.repair: Say and clap together slowly, then at normal speed.

skills.key_step: The child finds the part that repeats in a printed shape pattern and says what comes next.

floor.question: Red, blue, red, blue. What comes next?

contexts: a border for the class display

misconceptions.ask: Circle, square, circle, square, circle. What comes next?
misconceptions.repair: Say the pattern aloud and point: circle, square...

misconceptions.ask: A red circle, a red triangle, a red circle. What comes next?
misconceptions.repair: Cover the colours and look only at the shapes.

misconceptions.ask: Circle, circle, triangle, circle, circle. What comes next?
misconceptions.repair: Put a ring round each repeating part: circle, circle, triangle.

listen_for: slide the block across the paper
misconceptions.ask: How do you print a shape so it is clear?
misconceptions.repair: Print once by pressing and once by sliding; compare.

checks.question: Triangle, circle, triangle, circle. What comes next?
How do you lift the block after printing?
